amendment_sources_public_read_published.name: amendment_sources_public_read_published
amendment_sources_public_read_published.using:
exists (select 1 from amendments join texts on texts.id = amendments.text_id
                         where amendments.id = "amendment_sources"."amendment_id"
                           and amendments.status = 'published' and texts.status = 'published')

amendments_public_read_published.name: amendments_public_read_published
amendments_public_read_published.using:
"amendments"."status" = 'published'
                 and exists (select 1 from texts where texts.id = "amendments"."text_id" and texts.status = 'published')

group_votes_public_read_published.name: group_votes_public_read_published
group_votes_public_read_published.using:
exists (select 1 from votes join texts on texts.id = votes.text_id
                         left join amendments on amendments.id = votes.amendment_id
                         where votes.id = "group_votes"."vote_id" and texts.status = 'published'
                           and (votes.amendment_id is null or amendments.status = 'published'))

text_sources_public_read_published.name: text_sources_public_read_published
text_sources_public_read_published.using: exists (select 1 from texts where texts.id = "text_sources"."text_id" and texts.status = 'published')

text_subtopics_public_read_published.name: text_subtopics_public_read_published
text_subtopics_public_read_published.using: exists (select 1 from texts where texts.id = "text_subtopics"."text_id" and texts.status = 'published')

vote_sources_public_read_published.name: vote_sources_public_read_published
vote_sources_public_read_published.using:
exists (select 1 from votes join texts on texts.id = votes.text_id
                         left join amendments on amendments.id = votes.amendment_id
                         where votes.id = "vote_sources"."vote_id" and texts.status = 'published'
                           and (votes.amendment_id is null or amendments.status = 'published'))

votes_public_read_published.name: votes_public_read_published
votes_public_read_published.using:
exists (select 1 from texts where texts.id = "votes"."text_id" and texts.status = 'published')
                 and ("votes"."amendment_id" is null
                      or exists (select 1 from amendments
                                 where amendments.id = "votes"."amendment_id" and amendments.status = 'published'))

extract_sources_public_read_published.name: extract_sources_public_read_published
extract_sources_public_read_published.using:
exists (select 1 from extracts join candidacies on candidacies.id = extracts.candidacy_id
                         where extracts.id = "extract_sources"."extract_id" and extracts.status = 'published'
                           and candidacies.status = 'published')

extracts_public_read_published.name: extracts_public_read_published
extracts_public_read_published.using:
"extracts"."status" = 'published'
                 and exists (select 1 from candidacies
                             where candidacies.id = "extracts"."candidacy_id" and candidacies.status = 'published')
